verdict.rationale: Microsoft's Copilot privacy FAQ states that users can opt out of having their conversation activity used for model training at any time, and it names generative model training as a data use the opt-out covers. Users can also delete individual conversations or their entire history. One user's uncertainty about whether Word documents feed training is skepticism, not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: step-by-step documentation of where the opt-out setting lives, clear scope across integrated Office/365 Copilot surfaces and connected-service data, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out works.
